error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 2, Column SCDS11: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the bubble-point start, steps of at most 20 K (4 iterations, 13405 ms: the residual stopped falling); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 80.22 % of the way, after 16 steps, 132448 ms). Last residuals: material 119.7 mol/s, equilibrium 0.000002383, energy 3859000 W, specifications 2.132e-16. On the last iterate the liquid of stage 18 would split into two liquids: the column may hold two liquids there, which phases "VL" (one liquid) does not represent; turn on "look for two liquids on the stages" (phases "VLL", activity models). This does not show that the column has no solution: try other specifications (a larger reflux, another product flow), more stages, or another feed stage.. What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
